skill: Large, imperfect datasets from multiple systems
evidence: Seven fictional feeds plus 130,536 public cube cells; 29,745 daily time rows. Analysis reads and validates the complete selected data, without sampling.
Hash-pinned JSON-stat decoding, typed CSV ingestion and validated one-to-one HR/payroll joins.
Whitespace/case keys, decimal-comma FTE, critical-field rejection, exact deduplication and conflicting-record quarantine.

Trace a salary mismatch to an approved effective-dated change absent from payroll, distinguish an unsupported movement and explain a legitimate increase. Mechanisms are deliberately seeded, not employer findings.
Exact employee and approval lookups with explicit not-found markers; duplicate guards prevent first-match ambiguity.
Independent exact-match alternatives alongside XLOOKUP allow a reviewer to compare methods and missing-key treatment.
Nested IF/AND checks return ambiguous, missing, excluded, amount-exception or reconciled statuses; totals exclude unresolved gross.
Native Excel PivotTables summarise reconciliation by department/result and case governance by type/status. These are refreshable pivots, not pasted summary tables.
Validated exception status list, input thresholds and visual exception highlighting support an auditable follow-up workflow.
Public sector time series and synthetic control counts use explicit denominators, unit definitions and year-on-year comparisons.
As-of active headcount and FTE exclude conflicting masters, critical-field failures, future starters and leavers. Exclusions remain visible.
Employment-aware weekday exposure and FTE-weighted scheduled/lost hours; union overlapping episodes and cross-check against worked-time records. No diagnoses or real health information.
Approved salary/FTE/components versus recorded gross; separate signed variance, absolute discrepancies, missing amounts, duplicate/conflicting groups and inactive recurring pay.
Supported salary/variable-pay changes are not automatically flagged; unsupported movement, stale salary and allowance mismatch are separated.
Every exception has a source reference, owner, recommended action and review state; browser triage is labelled a simulation and never alters source records.

17-week mean-hours screening, completeness gates, logged daily-rest and break-duration reviews reference WRC guidance. Statutory calendar periods, leave adjustments, exemptions and weekly rest require further validation.
PIP case dates, owners, documentation and overdue reviews; no performance scores or automated decisions.

Expiry windows, missing owners, renewal submission and evidence status, with analyst-set 30/90-day service thresholds. No passport, nationality or actual immigration records.
Provider coordination, evidence verification, escalation and closure gates are specified; legal eligibility, applications and real sponsorship administration are not demonstrated.
BambooHR-style CSV field mapping, effective dates, key contracts and import preflight checks. No live BambooHR integration or platform SME claim.
Hire/end dates drive reporting inclusion; future-starter and leaver payment checks require approval/settlement review.
Source-to-control process map, payroll sign-off gates and a source-linked investigation SOP included with the deliverables.
Fixed seed/as-of date, hash-pinned source, immutable raw feeds, rebuild commands and executed tests; all outputs regenerate from source.
Recurring-error controls connect each exception family to preventive capture checks, accountable owners and escalation/closure evidence. Proposed controls, not measured employer impact.
Interactive public-data trends, reconciled-pay bridge, severity/area filters, absence heatmap and visa timeline with accessible data tables.
The interactive site demonstrates transferable reporting principles, not hands-on Power BI authoring. A Power BI model specification is provided as a next-step design.

Public/synthetic separation, least-privilege workflow, restricted-case escalation, minimisation and no trackers. No real confidential employee information is handled; practical experience cannot be inferred.
